title: Research: dirty-parity collapse extends to eight queries (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Answers open question 2 of [#2715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2715) in the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898): does the dirty-parity collapse that blocked free all-subset readout at `Q=7` also apply at eight queries?

| Readout model | Distinct-7 min R | One-dup min R | Tariff at X=0 | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| All-subset (free, illegal dirt) | **61** | 66 | **426** | yes (not legal) |
| Even-subset (#2677) | 74 | — | 452 | no |
| Parity-repaired odd sets | **74** | **82** | **452** | **no** |

Free all-subset reaches `R=61` (hypothetical tariff `426 < 436` even at `X=0`). Odd live-connector counts leave dirt. Minimal zero-slot parity repair restores even live-connector parity and collapses every covering distinct-7 schedule to even-subset `R≥74` (tariff `≥452`), matching [#2677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2677).

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2715) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/dirty-parity-8q-obstruction/`.
Tip: `d4d5f0f37929df97ea1e0f8d2bf0859f92407e55`.

Exact: free all-subset min R **61** (tariff **426**); parity-repair min R **74** (tariff **452**); no legal undercut of 436 after dirty-parity repair.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/dirty-parity-8q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/dirty-parity-8q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/dirty-parity-8q-obstruction/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/dirty-parity-8q-obstruction/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dirty-parity-8q-obstruction
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_DIRTY_PARITY_8Q_OBSTRUCTION all_subset_min_R=61 parity_repair_min_R=74 ... answers_cr7q_oq2 matches_2677_even_floor no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_DIRTY_PARITY_8Q covering=2430400 all_min=61 repair_min=74 ... answers_cr7q_oq2 no_new_kappa
PASS_DIRTY_PARITY_8Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/dirty-parity-8q-obstruction outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2715) (OQ2), [#2677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2677). Freestanding Q=8 dirty-parity fixture; no competing open PR at refresh.
